analysis:
Eaton fell 8.0%, tracking with its AI power and infrastructure peers, which declined a median 7.1% against a market drop of 4.4%. The stock moved roughly in line with peers like Vertiv (down 13.7%), GEV (down 7.4%), and VST (down 6.7%), while outperforming the group slightly. Coverage includes headlines about Eaton's CEO discussing AC to DC migration for data centers, a Rothschild price target adjustment to $402, and multiple pieces focused on peer companies Generac and Vertiv dealing with margin pressures and recent selloffs in the data center power space. 

The stock reports earnings on February 2, 89 days out, with estimates rising recently (nine upward revisions in the past 30 days, one down). Its earnings history shows a typical abnormal move of 3.9% beyond market effects around reports, but beating estimates has not reliably meant gains: four of the past seven beats were followed by negative abnormal moves, including a 6.7-point underperformance in August 2025 after a 0.9% beat.
